description: This file contains the PHP class 'Currency' within the Opencart admin namespace. It manages currency localization features including listing, form handling, CRUD operations, enabling/disabling currencies, and initiating currency data refresh. It interacts with models, views, session data, and other controllers to serve as the controller layer for currency management in the Opencart admin panel.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency localization including listing, CRUD operations, status toggling, deletion, and refresh in the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the currency listing page, initialize necessary data, and assemble view components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list currencies, returning the currency list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the currency list, including pagination and currency data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the currency creation/edit form, pre-filling data if editing an existing currency.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating currency data, validating input, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected currencies by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected currencies by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected currencies after validation for dependencies like default currency, stores, and orders.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Schedules a task to refresh currency data, protected by permission check.
